# apcore-mcp

> Automatic MCP server and OpenAI tools bridge for apcore — exposes apcore modules to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol with zero code changes.

apcore-mcp turns apcore modules into MCP tools (and OpenAI-compatible tool schemas) automatically: it converts schemas, maps behavior annotations, routes execution back to apcore, and serves it all as an MCP server over stdio, Streamable HTTP, or SSE.

## Start Here

- [Home](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/): What apcore-mcp does and how it bridges apcore modules to MCP and OpenAI tools.
- [Getting Started](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/getting-started/): Stand up an MCP server in front of your apcore modules with no code changes.
- [Configuration](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/configuration/): Configure transports, exposure, authentication, and bridge behavior.

## Features

- [Features Overview](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/overview/): Map of the bridge components from schema conversion to transport.
- [Schema Converter](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/schema-converter/): Converts apcore module schemas into MCP tool input schemas.
- [Annotation Mapper](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/annotation-mapper/): Maps apcore behavior annotations onto MCP tool metadata.
- [Execution Router](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/execution-router/): Routes MCP tool calls back to the apcore executor.
- [Error Mapper](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/error-mapper/): Translates apcore errors into MCP error responses with AI guidance metadata.
- [MCP Server Factory](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/mcp-server-factory/): Builds a ready-to-run MCP server from registered apcore modules.
- [OpenAI Converter](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/openai-converter/): Emits OpenAI-compatible tool/function schemas from the same modules.
- [Extension Bridge](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/extension-bridge/): Planned injection points for replacing the built-in converters and mappers.
- [Transport Manager](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/transport-manager/): Manages stdio/HTTP transports for the MCP server.
- [Registry Listener](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/registry-listener/): Keeps the exposed tool list in step with registry changes.
- [JWT Authenticator](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/jwt-authenticator/): Authenticates MCP callers via JWT at the bridge layer.
- [Approval Handler](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/approval-handler/): Bridges MCP elicitation to apcore's runtime approval gate.
- [Approval Handler (Phase B)](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/approval-phase-b/): Storage-backed approval flow for out-of-band decisions.
- [Async Task Bridge](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/async-task-bridge/): Runs long-lived modules as tasks with submit/status/cancel meta-tools.
- [Explorer UI](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/explorer-ui/): Browser UI to inspect and test exposed MCP tools.
- [Markdown](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/features/markdown/): Renders rich Markdown tool descriptions from apcore-toolkit.

## Specifications

- [Product Requirements](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/prd-apcore-mcp/): Goals, scope, and requirements for the MCP bridge.
- [Software Requirements](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/srs-apcore-mcp/): Detailed functional and non-functional requirements.
- [Technical Design](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/tech-design-apcore-mcp/): Architecture and component design of the bridge.
- [Test Plan](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/test-plan-apcore-mcp/): Test strategy and the per-requirement test cases every SDK must satisfy.
- [Examples Standard](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/examples-spec/): Normative cross-language layout every apcore-mcp implementation's examples must follow.

## Ecosystem

- [apcore](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/): The core schema-enforced module standard this bridge exposes.
- [apcore-a2a](https://apcore-a2a.aiperceivable.com/): Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol adapter for apcore.
- [apcore-cli](https://apcore-cli.aiperceivable.com/): Expose apcore modules as command-line tools.
- [apcore-toolkit](https://apcore-toolkit.aiperceivable.com/): Shared scanner, schema extraction, and output toolkit for adapters.
- [apflow](https://apflow.aiperceivable.com/): Orchestration layer for long-running, multi-step agent task workflows.
- [AI Perceivable (ecosystem hub)](https://aiperceivable.com/): Overview of the full ecosystem — apcore (perception), apflow (orchestration), and adapters.

## Key Facts

- Bridges apcore modules to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and OpenAI tools automatically.
- Zero code changes to existing apcore modules.
- Long-running modules run as async tasks with submit/status/cancel meta-tools.
- Supports JWT auth, multiple transports, and an Explorer UI.
- Open source. Source: https://github.com/aiperceivable/apcore-mcp
